breakdown.description: The centroid point load is replaced by a uniform traction over the hypotenuse
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified distributing the centroid force as a uniform traction over the hypotenuse. The generated specification correctly uses a `PointSource` to apply the vertical point load of -5000 N at coordinate (0.5, 0.25), which matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Represent each concentrated load with PointSource on the appropriate displacement component instead of smearing it over an edge.'
